name: Banned | 200mg Treats | Chocolate Wafer Stix
description:
Enjoy this delightful confection with BANNED Edible Co.’s Chocolate Covered Wafers. This addition to the Banned Edible Co. Chocolate Collection will not disappoint and provide the same potency and consistency that you have come to know and love from Banned. Premium Italian Wafers are imported directly from Italy where they are confected by the finest Italian bakers for a delightful crunch with a variety of silky smooth spreads perfectly distributed between the wafers. They are then delicately drizzled via waterfall with premium couverture milk chocolate for a silky smooth finish! Perfectly tailored for the budget-friendly consumer, BANNED Edible Co. ensures an unparalleled experience, never compromising on quality, flavor, or potency. Immerse yourself in the BANNED Effect by savoring the delicious creation that earned this brand the distinguished High Times Cannabis Cup Award. These delightful Chocolate Covered Wafers are sure to not disappoint! Experience The Banned Effect today!

Effects: Carefully dosed at 66.6 mg of THC in each wafer stick, the perfect dose to relax and send a user into a relaxing cloud of dreams. These wafer sticks are great for you to enjoy by yourself or split with a friend!
